verdict.rationale: Fellow's own pages say it records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams and Slack huddles. They also describe a visible bot or bot-free desktop capture, user control to record, pause or resume, and org-wide recording policies, which covers "recording where I want it." Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of capture reliability, and in-depth per-platform technical docs beyond marketing feature pages.
